overallSummary: Fabio Giglietto maintains a strong professional academic presence across LinkedIn, Bluesky, and Mastodon, totaling 3,580 followers. His content consistently focuses on computational social science, disinformation, coordinated inauthentic behavior, and research updates. Engagement across all channels is exceptionally high, driven by major announcements such as publications, grant awards, software releases, and job opportunities.

contentThemes.description: Sharing new research papers, grant wins, and conference presentations regarding coordinated campaigns and disinformation.
Updates on analytical software developments such as CooRnet v2.0.
Posts advertising postdoctoral researcher positions and PhD opportunities in computational social science.

recommendations: Cross-post high-performing recruitment calls and publication announcements across all platforms to maximize audience reach.
Leverage Bluesky's high amplification (reposts) to spark discussions around methodological developments.
Include direct links and calls-to-action on LinkedIn posts to capitalize on its large audience size and strong comment activity.

platformInsights.bluesky: Demonstrates the highest engagement rate (average 6.14%), driven by strong resharing and virality among the academic and data science community.
platformInsights.mastodon: Provides solid niche engagement (average 4.55% engagement rate) specifically focused on open-source tool updates and technical methodology discussions.
platformInsights.linkedin: Serves as the primary audience hub with 1,850 followers and generates the highest absolute engagement per post (average 90 interactions), particularly around career and grant milestones.
